title: VA Healthcare and Disability Benefits in Plain English
bigPicture: The VA provides medical care and monthly payments to veterans who got sick or injured during service.
whatYouNeedToKnow: You need proof of military service to qualify.
Disability pay depends on how much your condition limits daily life.
Healthcare is often free or low-cost based on income and service history.
You can get both healthcare and disability pay at the same time.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Waiting too long to file a disability claim.
Losing medical records or service papers.
Thinking you don't qualify because of age or income.
actionSteps: Find your military discharge papers and medical records.
Go to va.gov or call 1-800-827-1000 to apply.
Ask a VA counselor for help if you get stuck.
